name: gallery-mode
description: Stash plugin that adds gallery mode for viewing still frames

scripts.sync: test -n "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" || (echo 'Error: STASH_PLUGIN_DIR not set' && exit 1) && rm -rf "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" && mkdir -p "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" && cp gallery.js GalleryMode.yml GalleryMode.py "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR/"
